integrity: Exact finite group/nerve/action checks for n=2,...,7 accompany an infinite-parameter structural proof. No experiments are presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The nonequivariant wedge rank was proved in the earlier literature; only the explicit integral left-action module, equivariant graph model, full character, and ordinary orbit quotient are proposed as additional content. No independent audit; unindexed equivalents remain possible.
title: The integral equivariant homology of dicyclic abelian-coset complexes
